summary_1line: Kaurava leaders suspect the disguised Arjuna as ominous signs appear, while he brings Uttara to the Sami tree to retrieve the hidden Pandava weapons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna disguised as the eunuch Brihannala drives the chariot toward the Sami tree while terrified Prince Uttara sits beside him and the distant Kaurava army watches.
Ominous portents fill the battlefield as jackals howl, banners tremble without wind, and warriors stare uneasily while Drona declares the approaching hero to be Arjuna.
Prince Uttara climbs the thick Sami tree and uncovers the radiant Gandiva and other Pandava bows shining like rising planets.
